parse.wikitext:
===Pickpocket chance===
As they have the same level requirement, the success rates for H.A.M members are likewise the same between men and women.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1253611154192109568|date=24 April 2020|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/102309|archivedate=28 May 2020|quote=At level 1, that'd be 53%, 46% and 29% respectively. At level 99, all of them are 94%. Interpolate linearly between those.|notes=The numbers cited for the female H.A.M. members are taken as indicative for the skilling success chart on this page, under the assumption that both genders now share the same success chance that was historically assigned to female H.A.M. members.}} With the addition of the [[Hard Ardougne Diary]], this chance gains a 10% bonus.
